text: Want your whole class cheering during a quiz? Meet Oomba Live.
Pick any subject and any level, and you're ready in seconds.
Students join with a simple code. No accounts, no setup.
Every right answer moves their racer forward, so the whole room is in the race, and everyone is learning.

scene: the Builder: a kid types an idea (22.15)
text: And when the quiz is over? Kids become the makers.
They describe a game in their own words. The Builder makes it, then plays it to check that it works.
Then it's theirs to play, and to share with the class.
Plus a growing library of learning games, from geography to chess, in thirteen languages.
Oomba Live. Free for teachers at oomba.ai.
